services.title: Wedding Photography
services.description: From the first look to the final dance, I capture every precious moment of your special day. Full-day coverage includes ceremony, reception, couple portraits, and candid family moments.

services.title: Maternity Sessions
services.description: Celebrate the beautiful journey of motherhood with intimate maternity portraits. Studio or outdoor shoots available, capturing the glow and anticipation before your baby arrives.

services.title: Newborn Photography
services.description: Your baby's first days are fleeting. Professional newborn sessions capture those tiny fingers, sweet expressions, and peaceful moments in the first 14 days of life.

services.title: Family Portraits
services.description: Create lasting memories with professional family portraits. Whether it's an annual tradition or a special milestone, I'll capture the love and connection that makes your family unique.

services.title: Matric Portraits
services.description: Make your matric farewell unforgettable with stunning portraits that capture this important milestone. Individual and group sessions available for matric students across Gauteng.

services.title: Cake Smash Sessions
services.description: Celebrate baby's first birthday with a fun cake smash session! These playful shoots create adorable memories as your little one explores their cake and makes a delightful mess.

services.title: Couples Photography
services.description: Whether you're newly engaged, celebrating an anniversary, or simply want to capture your love story, couples sessions create romantic portraits you'll treasure forever.

services.title: Custom Photo Albums
services.description: Transform your favorite images into heirloom-quality photo albums. Choose from classic layflat designs, leather-bound collections, or modern acrylic covers. Starting from R2100.

faq.answer: Contact us via phone or email for a free, no-obligation quote.

faq.answer: We serve Gauteng and surrounding areas.

faq.question: How far in advance should I book a session?
faq.answer: For weddings, I recommend booking 6-12 months in advance. For other sessions (maternity, newborn, family), 2-4 weeks notice is usually sufficient, though I can sometimes accommodate last-minute bookings.

faq.question: What happens if it rains on the day of an outdoor shoot?
faq.answer: We'll monitor the weather forecast together. If rain is expected, we can either reschedule to another day at no extra cost, or move to an indoor location or covered outdoor area.

faq.question: How long does it take to receive my photos?
faq.answer: You'll receive your edited photos within 2-3 weeks for most sessions. Wedding galleries typically take 4-6 weeks due to the volume of images. Rush delivery is available for an additional fee if you need your photos sooner.

faq.question: Do you provide the digital files or only prints?
faq.answer: All packages include high-resolution digital files delivered via an online gallery where you can download, share, and order prints. Print-ready files are included so you can print wherever you prefer.

faq.question: Can I bring props or outfits to the session?
faq.answer: Absolutely! I encourage you to bring meaningful items, special outfits, or props that represent your personality. For newborn and cake smash sessions, I provide props, but you're welcome to bring your own as well.

faq.question: Do you travel outside of Gauteng?
faq.answer: Yes, I'm happy to travel for weddings and special events. Travel fees apply for locations outside Gauteng, which we'll discuss during your consultation.

faq.question: What's the best age for newborn photos?
faq.answer: The ideal window is 5-14 days after birth when babies are still very sleepy and curly. However, I can photograph older babies too - every age has its own beauty!

faq.question: Do you offer payment plans?
faq.answer: Yes! For wedding packages and larger bookings, I offer flexible payment plans. A 30% deposit secures your date, with the balance due before or on the session date.

about.headline: Hi, I'm Tammy!
about.story:
Photography isn't just my profession—it's my passion. For over a decade, I've had the privilege of documenting life's most precious moments across Gauteng. From the joy of a wedding day to the quiet intimacy of a newborn's first photos, I believe every moment deserves to be remembered beautifully.

My approach is simple: I want you to feel comfortable, natural, and like yourself. The best photos happen when you forget the camera is there and simply enjoy the moment. Whether we're capturing your growing family, celebrating a milestone, or creating art together, my goal is to give you images that make you smile every single time you see them.

When I'm not behind the camera, I'm probably planning the next shoot, editing in my cozy home studio, or spending time with my own family. I understand how quickly time flies and how important it is to freeze these fleeting moments. That's why I pour my heart into every session—because your memories matter.
